THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 13.09.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 CRL.MC NO. 31 OF 2018 2  2024:KER:70127  P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN, J  --------------------------------------
 Crl.M.C. No. 31 of 2018  --------------------------------------
 Dated this the 13th day of September, 2024  ORDER This Criminal Miscellaneous case is filed to quash the FIR in Crime No. 222/2017 of Museum Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram.
The offence alleged in the FIR is under Sec. 420 IPC.
This Crl.M.C. is pending before this Court from 2018 onwards.
Probably, the final report might have been filed.
If the final report is filed and the petitioner is aggrieved by the same, the petitioner is free to challenge the same, in accordance with law.
With the above observation, this Crl.M.C. is disposed of.

Sd/-
